statement: Closest existing work and overlap: DrKGC is the closest in mechanism (query-specific subgraph + LLM fine-tuning with structural injection), GNN-RAG and SG-RAG MOT are closest in the 'context beyond the path/triple' idea (shortest-path context; merged/ordered triplet subgraphs), and NSM is closest in motivation (missing intermediate supervision causes spurious reasoning). Overlap is substantial on the context family and the multi-hop KGQA benchmarks; the uncovered element is specifically context derived from a supervision triple's source passage and used as the training supervision signal rather than retrieved at inference.
